title: GMV
question: 上个月 GMV 环比怎么样？
sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    THEN '2026-09'
    ELSE '2026-08'
  END AS period,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND (
    o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    OR o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  )
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    THEN '2026-09'
    ELSE '2026-08'
  END
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 1000
